name: Nyx Bavlenka
source:
Nyx is the youngest daughter of Grand Duke Bavlenka. Although she is adopted, she has gained her father's favor. The duke wants her to be active in the social circles however, this shy bookish girl seems to have no clue about it.

[From [url=https://helix-waltz.fandom.com/wiki/Nyx_Bavlenka]Helix Waltz Wiki[/url]]
